item.title: Why Incus, and Why I Wrote incus-fleet Myself
item.description: The first nine posts built the virtualization base on a small self-hosted setup: installing Incus, forming the cluster, working out quorum, settling storage and memory, wiring up cross-node networking, taking incus move apart, surveying the web UI ecosystem, researching multi-cluster and cross-cluster migration, and landing on the self-built incus-hub. This post completes the reasoning behind the three decisions: the base, the console, and whether to write the code at all.
